decisions.reason: The retention and protection functions of R7 and R8 are already fully represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY.
Approval to retain R7 and R8 for DW01A electrical protection does not change the separate NTC thermal-monitoring requirement.
Retaining protection resistors does not change connector placement, orientation, accessibility, or mounting-hole clearance.
The component-retention approval does not alter the established power-board dimensions, orientation, or mounting constraints.
The DW01A resistor decision does not affect the charge-status display method, GPIO, or dedicated-LED policy.
The same client acceptance already has a complete candidate MODIFY retaining the zero-ohm I2C resistors for voltage-spike conditioning.
Approval of R7 and R8 does not change the interboard connector partition, types, signal pinout, or pin-order policy.
The protection-resistor approval does not affect the selected addressable LED family or its data GPIO.
R7 and R8 serve the DW01A protection circuit and do not change the MT3608 enable control or 5V-rail behavior.
Retaining DW01A protection resistors does not change the battery connector family, pitch, pin count, pin functions, or part number.
The protection-component decision does not affect native USB data lines, connector sourceability, or interboard USB routing.
